questions.q: What is the main difference between Import and DirectQuery when connecting to SQL Server?
options: Import copies data into the Power BI file; DirectQuery queries the source at report time
Import works only with CSV files
DirectQuery copies all data into memory; Import never stores any data
There is no difference; they are two names for the same mode
questions.explain: Import stores a snapshot in the file (refresh to update). DirectQuery keeps data in the source and queries it when the report is used.

questions.q: Why might you paste a SQL statement under the SQL Server connector's advanced options?
options: To install Python packages
To let the database do filtering and aggregation and load only a small result
To change Power BI's color theme
To convert the file to a .pbix
questions.explain: A native SQL statement pushes the heavy work to the database, so Power BI loads only the shaped result.

questions.q: In Power BI Desktop, which kind of object does a Python script data source import?
options: Any Python variable, including lists and strings
Only NumPy arrays
Matplotlib figures
Only pandas data frames
questions.explain: Per Microsoft's documentation, only pandas data frames import, so data must be in a data frame.

questions.q: In Transform > Run Python script, how does the current table reach your code?
options: As a CSV file path in sys.argv
As a pandas data frame named dataset
As a global list called rows
It doesn't; the script must re-query the source
questions.explain: The Run Python script step passes the current table as a pandas data frame named dataset.

questions.q: Which of these is a documented limitation to consider before relying on Python in a shared Power BI report?
options: Python scripts can only contain one line
Power BI cannot read CSV files
Refreshing a Python-based dataset in the service requires a Personal Gateway, and data sources need a Public privacy level
Python data frames cannot contain numbers
questions.explain: As of the documentation reviewed, scheduled refresh of Python-based datasets needs a Personal Gateway, and privacy levels for the involved sources must be Public. Check current docs, since details change.
